findings.finding: In Q1 2026 a 22% inventory impact sat inside TEPEZZA's 29% growth (about $84M of stocking on a $381M base), about 1.1 points of Amgen's 4.4 points of Q1 product-sales growth; U.S. TEPEZZA grew only 16% ($424M vs $365M), while the Q1 call described the $490M global figure as U.S. sales and credited demand. The stocking was limited to Q1: about $20M unwound in Q2 and about $62M was still in the channel at the end of Q2.
